summary: Monitoring alert MON-018 flagged online transaction 3491098 ($99.94) on card C08804-K1 after the second-generation model scored it at 0.993 with a calibrated historical fraud rate of 92.1%. The transaction originated through an anonymous proxy from device D000360, representing an abrupt channel shift to online ordering and product H in region 512, which deviates completely from the cardholder's historical baseline of in-person purchases in region 343. Although device D000360 shows no known fraud ring links and the account has no prior fraud record, the proxy masking and significant behavioral anomaly strongly corroborate the model score. The activity is classified as card-not-present fraud with a 0.925 probability, resulting in a card block and formal case creation.
open_question: Whether the cardholder legitimately initiated this online purchase while using a personal VPN / private relay, or whether card credentials were used fraudulently online. Cardholder contact to confirm authorization of transaction 3491098 would resolve the case definitively.
